{{Top|leg}}
A '''sim-vacation''', or '''sim-voyage''', was a popular recreational activity that used simulator
and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Hologram/Legends|technologies]] to create for diverse beings a [[virtual reality]] luxury-vacation experience to beautiful tourist spots, popular throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Advanced [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] systems created the simulated images and sound for the virtual vacationer. Some of the simulated galactic locales and attractions included the famous [[Meteor/Legends|shooting stars]] of [[Nantama]], the [[mountain]]s of [[Belazura]], and [[Dremulae]]'s [[Sea of Translucency]].<ref name=":0">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>

Sim-vacations were particularly popular on the capital world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A business called "[[Virtual Happiness]]" was, for example, one of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City's]] several establishments specializing in sim-voyages. Ironically, after it went out of business, its original structure in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district served as a ''safe house'' for [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] criminal and mad [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], whose own brand of 'virtual happiness' transported another breed of virtual realist in an entirely different kind of way, through her drug, "[[Zone of Self-Containment|The Zone of Self-Containment]]."<ref name=":0" />
